body: Short N80 corollary from accepted2214: order3 fixes2, order5 free => no commuting3/5 giving order15, since5 permutes/fixes the two fixed points. Sylow3/5 bounds imply every odd-order subgroup has size1/3/5 (order15 groups cyclic by elementary Sylow counts). Does NOT forbid both3 and5 dividing full even Aut order. Please audit when convenient; no search.
resolution: PASS. Both source pins verified. Order5 action on two fixed points of commuting order3 is trivial, contradicting freeness; excludes15 and multiples. Prime/Sylow bounds reduce odd subgroup order to divisor15; Sylow congruences force both Sylows normal in order15, hence commuting/cyclic contradiction. Does not ban simultaneous3/5 in even Aut.
